  "description": "The People Office is an HR consulting firm that helps businesses build better teams, streamline HR processes, and create effective people management systems. We provide services including recruitment and talent placement, HR setup, employee management, policies and documentation, performance management, and organisational development. Our goal is to help growing businesses attract, manage, and retain the right talent while building structured, productive, and sustainable organisations.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Architect
Job Location: Lekki, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time
Department: Design and Projects
Reports To: Creative Director

Job Summary


	The Architect will be responsible for developing architectural concepts, preparing technical drawings, coordinating design documentation, and supporting the execution of interior design and renovation projects.
	The role involves translating client briefs and design concepts into practical, functional, aesthetically pleasing, and technically sound spaces. The Architect will collaborate closely with interior designers, project managers, contractors, artisans, and other stakeholders to ensure that designs are accurately interpreted and implemented.
	The ideal candidate must have strong design skills, technical knowledge, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple design assignments while meeting project deadlines and quality standards.


Key Responsibilities
Architectural Design and Space Planning:


	Develop architectural concepts and design solutions based on client briefs, project requirements, and approved budgets.
	Prepare space plans, layouts, elevations, sections, and other architectural design documents.
	Develop design concepts that balance functionality, aesthetics, comfort, and efficient use of space.
	Conduct site assessments and measurements to understand existing conditions and project requirements.
	Recommend appropriate layouts, finishes, materials, and architectural elements.
	Collaborate with interior designers to ensure architectural features complement the overall interior design concept.
	Revise designs based on client feedback, technical requirements, and management approvals.


Technical Drawings and Documentation:


	Prepare detailed architectural drawings for design development and project execution.
	Produce floor plans, reflected ceiling plans, elevations, sections, joinery details, and construction drawings where required.
	Prepare accurate measurements, dimensions, and technical specifications.
	Ensure drawings are coordinated with relevant structural, mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and interior design requirements.
	Maintain accurate drawing records and ensure revisions are properly documented.
	Ensure all drawings are reviewed and approved by the appropriate personnel before implementation.
	Prepare as-built drawings where required.


&nbsp;3D Visualisation and Design Presentation:


	Develop 3D models, architectural visualisations, and renderings to communicate design concepts.
	Prepare presentation materials for client consultations and internal design reviews.
	Use design software to illustrate proposed layouts, finishes, lighting arrangements, and architectural features.
	Incorporate approved client feedback into design revisions.
	Ensure visual presentations accurately reflect the intended design direction and technical requirements.


Materials and Technical Specifications


	Research and recommend suitable building materials, finishes, fittings, and architectural components.
	Prepare material schedules and specifications in line with approved design concepts and project budgets.
	Work with the procurement team to identify appropriate suppliers and assess material options.
	Consider durability, functionality, maintenance, availability, and cost when recommending materials.
	Review samples and material selections to ensure consistency with approved designs.
	Coordinate the preparation of schedules for doors, windows, finishes, fixtures, and other relevant architectural elements.


Site Inspections and Project Coordination:


	Conduct site visits to assess existing conditions and monitor implementation of approved designs.
	Work closely with the Project Manager to clarify drawings, technical details, and design requirements.
	Respond to technical queries from contractors, artisans, and installation teams within the scope of the role.
	Identify discrepancies between approved drawings and actual site conditions.
	Recommend appropriate design adjustments where unforeseen site conditions arise.
	Document site observations, technical issues, and required corrective actions.
	Review completed work to identify deviations from approved architectural drawings and specifications.
	Participate in snagging inspections and project handover activities.


Client and Stakeholder Collaboration:


	Participate in client meetings, design presentations, and project briefings.
	Clarify architectural requirements and explain proposed design solutions to clients.
	Collaborate with interior designers, project managers, engineers, consultants, and contractors.
	Incorporate approved feedback into architectural drawings and design documentation.
	Communicate technical constraints and design implications to relevant stakeholders.
	Support the preparation of design proposals, project documentation, and technical presentations.


Quality Assurance and Compliance


	Ensure architectural drawings and design documentation meet applicable building regulations and relevant technical standards.
	Identify potential design conflicts and technical challenges before construction or installation.
	Coordinate with qualified consultants where structural, mechanical, electrical, or other specialist input is required.
	Ensure designs consider functionality, accessibility, safety, and practical execution.
	Support the implementation of appropriate quality-control procedures throughout the project lifecycle.
	Ensure that drawings requiring professional review, approval, or statutory sign-off are handled by appropriately qualified and registered professionals.


Project Documentation and Reporting:


	Maintain organised records of architectural drawings, design revisions, specifications, and approvals.
	Submit design deliverables according to agreed project schedules.
	Provide regular updates on design progress, outstanding information, and technical challenges.
	Maintain a tracker of assigned projects, drawing status, pending approvals, and deadlines.
	Escalate delays, design conflicts, and resource requirements to the Head of Design or Project Manager.
	Support the preparation of project completion documentation and as-built records.


Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
The Architect&#39;s performance will be evaluated using the following indicators:


	Design Delivery: Percentage of assigned design deliverables completed within agreed timelines.
	Drawing Accuracy: Accuracy, completeness, and technical quality of architectural drawings.
	Design Quality: Alignment of design outputs with approved client briefs and company standards.
	Revision Management: Timeliness and accuracy of design revisions following approved feedback.
	Technical Coordination: Effectiveness in identifying and resolving design conflicts before execution.
	Site Compliance: Number and severity of avoidable discrepancies between approved drawings and executed work.
	Documentation: Accuracy and completeness of drawings, specifications, and project records.
	Collaboration: Effectiveness in working with designers, project managers, contractors, and other stakeholders.
	Client Satisfaction: Feedback on design quality, presentation, functionality, and responsiveness.
	Project Support: Timeliness in responding to technical queries and providing necessary design clarifications.


Qualifications and Experience


	Bachelor&#39;s degree in Architecture or an equivalent recognised qualification.
	1&ndash;5 years of relevant architectural design experience.
	Experience in interior design, residential or commercial fit-outs, renovations, or architectural projects is an advantage.
	Strong portfolio demonstrating architectural design, technical drawings, and space-planning capabilities.
	Proficiency in AutoCAD and relevant architectural design software.
	Experience with SketchUp, Revit, 3ds Max, Lumion, Enscape, V-Ray, or similar visualisation tools is an advantage.
	Familiarity with building materials, construction methods, and site coordination.
	Relevant professional registration or eligibility for registration, as required by the responsibilities and applicable Nigerian regulations.


Required Skills and Competencies:


	Strong architectural design and space-planning skills.
	Excellent technical drawing and detailing abilities.
	Good understanding of construction methods and interior fit-out processes.
	Strong visualisation and presentation skills.
	High attention to detail and accuracy.
	Ability to interpret client briefs and translate them into practical design solutions.
	Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
	Effective communication and collaboration skills.
	Ability to manage multiple assignments and competing deadlines.
	Good understanding of material specifications, finishes, and design coordination.
	Proficiency in relevant design and documentation software.
	Ability to receive feedback and revise designs appropriately.


Personal Attributes
The ideal candidate should be:


	Creative and technically minded.
	Detail-oriented and quality-conscious.
	Organised and dependable.
	Ownership Mindset
	Proactive in identifying design challenges.
	Open to feedback and continuous improvement.
	Collaborative and professional.
	Able to work under pressure and meet deadlines.
	Committed to producing practical, functional, and aesthetically strong designs.


Salary
N200,000 per month.

  "description": "Ascentech Services Limited is a full-fledged Human Resource Solution Provider incorporated in 2013 with its Head Office in Lagos, Nigeria. We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Operations Executive &ndash; Customs Clearing
Job Location: Port Harcourt, Rivers
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary


	We are seeking an experienced Operations Executive &ndash; Customs Clearing to coordinate import and export customs clearance, ensure regulatory compliance, and facilitate the timely and cost-effective release of cargo.


Key Responsibilities


	Prepare and process import/export customs clearance documentation.
	Liaise with licensed customs agents, the Nigeria Customs Service (NCS), shipping lines, port terminals, and relevant regulatory agencies.
	Coordinate customs declarations, duty assessments, cargo examinations, and release procedures.
	Verify shipping documents, invoices, packing lists, permits, and other clearance requirements.
	Track shipments, resolve clearance delays, and address documentation discrepancies.
	Monitor customs duties, port charges, demurrage, detention, and other clearance costs.
	Coordinate cargo collection, release, and handover to haulage teams.
	Maintain accurate records and provide regular shipment status updates.

	Facilitate transparent selection of members and supervised elections of the Facility Management Committees, with protected seats for a Women&#39;s Lead, a Youth Lead and a landowner representative.

	Set up and support the LGA Facility Oversight Committees in MMC, Jere and Mafa. Provide technical support to the secretariat of the State Asset Oversight Committee.
	Train committees in leadership, transparent decision-making, inclusive participation and accountability to members.
	Put the safeguards against elite capture in place: public display of membership lists and plot allocations, quarterly social audits, and General Assembly meetings.

	Facilitate community dialogues between landowners, host communities, IDPs and returnees, women and youth, and government officials, to agree a shared vision for each facility.

	Organise landowner recognition events at commissioning, together with traditional and government leaders.
	Coordinate quarterly joint monitoring visits and the twice-yearly community open days.
	Set up, train and mentor Peace and Grievance Committees in mediation and dispute resolution. Make sure they include traditional, religious, women, youth, landowner and IDP/returnee representatives.
	Mediate disputes over land, access, water allocation, membership and benefits directly. Escalate unresolved cases through the agreed path: facility committee, then traditional leader and LGA mediation, then the Facility Oversight Committee.


Early warning and accountability:


	Maintain a log of tensions, disputes and how they were resolved. Report it every two months to the LGA Oversight Committees and monthly to the Project Manager.
	Make sure grievances are linked to the Feedback and Complaints Response Mechanism (FCRM). Refer protection concerns to the Protection focal point.
	Help design and analyse the social cohesion perception survey (baseline and endline) with the MEAL Officer.


Supervision of community mobilisers:


	Plan and supervise the community and committee work of the three community mobilisers.
	Train them in facilitation, mediation basics, conflict sensitivity and safe referral.
	Review their reports, and check the quality and inclusiveness of meetings they organise.


Handover readiness:


	Assess the ownership, governance, inclusion and cohesion criteria of the handover readiness scorecard for each facility.
	Document lessons learned on ownership resolution and social cohesion for WFP and partners.


Cross-cutting duties:


	Stay impartial and be seen to be impartial. Never take sides in disputes or make commitments on behalf of government or landowners.
	Make sure at least 40% of members of every governance structure are women and youth, and that persons with disabilities, returnees and IDPs take part meaningfully.
	Follow PSEA, safeguarding, confidentiality and security procedures.
	Carry out any other reasonable duties related to the project, as assigned by the Project


Qualifications, experience and competencies
Education:


	Essential: a university degree (B.Sc or HND) in Peace and Conflict Studies, Sociology, Political Science, Law, Public Administration, Development Studies or a related social science.
	Desirable: a Master&#39;s degree in Peace and Conflict Studies, Development or Law.


Essential:


	At least 4 years of experience in social cohesion, peace building, community governance or conflict-sensitive programming.
	Proven experience facilitating community dialogues and mediating disputes, preferably over land, water or shared resources.
	Experience setting up or strengthening community structures such as committees, cooperatives, WUAs or peace committees, including elections and constitutions.
	Experience working with traditional institutions and State and LGAs in North-East Nigeria.
	Experience with NGOs, UN agencies or government programmes in humanitarian or recovery settings.


Desirable:


	Experience negotiating land-use, asset handover or community ownership agreements.
	Knowledge of customary and statutory land tenure in Borno State, including the Land Use Act.
	Experience with livelihoods, WASH or infrastructure projects where communities share assets.
	Experience with Accountability to Affected Populations (AAP) and feedback mechanisms.


Skills and competencies:


	Excellent facilitation, negotiation and mediation skills.
	Able to stay neutral, build trust and handle sensitive information with discretion.
	Strong analysis of power and conflict dynamics, and sound judgement on risk.
	Clear writing of agreements, meeting records and reports.
	Cultural sensitivity and respect for local customs, with a commitment to inclusion of women, youth, persons with disabilities, IDPs and returnees.
	Commitment to PSEA, safeguarding and humanitarian principles.
	Proficient in MS Office or Google Workspace.


Languages:


	Essential: fluent English and Hausa.
	Strongly desirable: fluent Kanuri.
